problem: The product-led Powerhouse homepage had merged to protected main while Netlify production still served an older commit_ref.
root_cause: A website runtime change reached protected main without a fresh successful Netlify production build becoming current; production truth therefore lagged repository truth.
prevention: Every product-led homepage runtime change must end with a fresh Netlify production build from the exact protected-main lineage.
A production promotion is incomplete until Netlify commit_ref contains the merged homepage change and the public homepage exposes Powerhouse Intelligence, Powerhouse Agents and Powerhouse Connect.
Use a bounded redeploy heartbeat only to retrigger the provider when repository truth is ahead of production truth.
